name: Archivist
summary: A scholarly bard who turns exhaustive study into tactical insight, magical expertise, and reliable predictions.

features.name: Naturalist +1
features.summary: After identifying a specific kind of creature, grant nearby allies an insight bonus to AC, attacks, and saves against its extraordinary, supernatural, and spell-like abilities.
features.scaling: +1; increases at 5th level and every 6 levels thereafter

features.name: Lamentable Belaborment
features.summary: While maintaining Fascinate, bewilder one fascinated creature and leave it dazed or confused on a failed Will save.

features.name: Pedantic Lecture
features.summary: Use Lamentable Belaborment against every creature currently fascinated and optionally put affected targets to sleep.

features.name: Lore Master
features.summary: Take 20 on a Knowledge check once per day, plus one additional time per six levels beyond 2nd.

features.name: Magic Lore
features.summary: Add half Bard level to Spellcraft checks for magic items and scrolls, take 10 on them, disable magical traps, and gain +4 saves against magical traps and magical writings.
features.scaling: half Bard level to qualifying Spellcraft checks

features.name: Jack of All Trades: Untrained Skills
features.summary: Use any skill even when it normally requires training.

features.name: Jack of All Trades: Class Skills
features.summary: Treat every skill as a class skill.

features.name: Jack of All Trades: Take 10
features.summary: Take 10 on any skill check even when normally prohibited.

features.name: Probable Path
features.summary: Take 10 on any d20 roll once per day, gaining another daily use every three levels after 10th.
